questions.q: What is the main job of an exploratory report, as opposed to an executive dashboard?
options: To be a workbench where you ask questions quickly and decide where to look next
To replace every notebook you would otherwise write
To hide the underlying data from viewers
To display as many charts as possible on one page
questions.explain: An exploratory report is for the analyst: linked visuals, quick questions, and follow-up ideas.

questions.q: In the suggested skeleton, which page corresponds to bivariate analysis?
options: The overview page with the churn card
The distributions page
The relationships page, breaking churn down by plan, region, or tickets
None of them; Power BI cannot do bivariate views
questions.explain: Comparing churn against another variable is a bivariate view, so it belongs on the relationships page.

questions.q: What does the Edit interactions button on the Format tab let you do?
options: Install Python for Power BI
Control how selecting one visual affects the others on the page
Publish the report to the service
Remove duplicate rows from the data
questions.explain: Edit interactions controls which visuals respond to a selection, so filtering does not mislead.

questions.q: A Python visual receives only two columns, support_tickets and churned. Why can the row count silently shrink?
options: Python visuals always drop the first 800 rows
Matplotlib removes rows before plotting
The visual groups fields like a table visual, so duplicate rows appear only once; adding a unique ID prevents this
Power BI converts every column to text
questions.explain: Per the Microsoft docs, duplicates collapse. In our check, 800 customers reduced to 13 distinct rows until customer_id was added.

questions.q: Which statement about Python visuals matches the documentation as of this writing?
options: They are fully interactive and can cross-filter other visuals when you click a point
They have no row limit at all
They work without any local Python installation in Desktop
The resulting image is static, though it responds to filtering and highlighting from other visuals
questions.explain: The image is not interactive; you cannot click elements in it to cross-filter. Desktop also needs local Python with pandas and matplotlib.
